Upgrade Health employs dedicated allied health professionals from around the World, who focus on physiotherapy, occupational therapy, podiatry, speech pathology, psychology, remedial massage, and pilates. Commencing immediately.

Salary range: $80,000 - $110,000 + performance driven bonuses.

Reporting to the Director you will be responsible for providing our clients with care and taking accountability in their journey back to better health, while aligning yourself with our core Values; Care, Excellence, Collaboration, Growth.
Right now, Upgrade Health has a rare opportunity for an experienced Occupational Therapist to join our rapidly growing team.

As a qualified occupational therapist, you will assess, treat and prevent physical difficulties resulting from injury, illness, disability or ageing to improve movement and general wellbeing. In this role, you will have the opportunity to independently manage a varied caseload of NDIS Clients including Private Patients, DVA, Workcover & EPC Clients.

What we offer:
? An Employer/Employee Value Proposition like you never experienced
? Competitive salary and benefits package
? Ongoing professional learning and development including mentoring and coaching
? A diverse and inclusive work environment
? Career pathways and networking opportunities
? Organised 1:1’s, fortnightly teaching and journal clubs
? Fully equipped practices with pilates reformer, shock therapy, acupuncture, exercise physiology, massage therapy, computerised gait analysis, advanced posture screening software, OH&S training and rehabilitation, manual handling seminars

What you offer:
? Bachelor degree or higher qualification in Occupational Therapy
? AHPRA registration required
? At least 2 years’ experience as a registered Occupational Therapist with 1-year experience in private practice
? Understanding of the rights of people with a disability
? Current Valid Driver's License
?Current Working with Children Check or willingness to obtain one before commencement

Are you interested? Apply today.

Oversee the day-to-day operations of the business which involves managing a team, ensuring efficient delivery of services, maintaining client relationships, and contributing to the strategic planning and execution of business objectives.

Leadership and Management:
Develop and manage the organisation’s administrative, financial, physical and staff resources
Provide training, mentorship, and performance evaluations to staff.
Foster a positive and productive work environment.

Ensure the efficient and effective delivery of business services.

Monitor and manage departmental budgets and expenses.

Strategic Planning and Execution:

Implement strategies to enhance service delivery and client satisfaction.
Identify opportunities for business growth and development.

Client Relationship Management:
Represent the organisation in negotiations, and at conventions, seminars, public hearings and forums, and promoting existing and new programs and policies
Build and maintain strong client relationships.
Address and resolve client issues and concerns promptly.

Quality Control and Improvement:
Monitor service quality and implement improvements as needed.
Conduct regular audits and assessments.
Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations.

Reporting and Analysis:
Prepare and present regular reports on departmental performance.
Analyse data to identify trends and areas for improvement.
Utilise data to inform decision-making and strategic planning.

Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, or a related field.
Proven experience in a managerial role within business services or a similar field.
Experience in client relationship management.
Knowledge of industry-specific regulations and standards.
Strong leadership and team management skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Proficiency in business management software and tools.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

About Upgrade Health

Upgrade Health employs dedicated allied health professionals from around the World, who focus on physiotherapy, occupational therapy, podiatry, speech pathology, psychology, remedial massage, and pilates.  We also specialise in occupational rehabilitation including workplace assessments, suitable duties programs, return to work plans and pre-employment assessments.

Commencing immediately.

Salary range: $80,000 - $110,000 + performance driven bonuses.

Reporting to the Director you will be responsible for providing our clients with care and taking accountability in their journey back to better health, while aligning yourself with our core Values; Care, Excellence, Collaboration, Growth.
Right now, Upgrade Health has a rare opportunity for an experienced Occupational Therapist to join our rapidly growing team.

As a qualified occupational therapist, you will assess, treat and prevent physical difficulties resulting from injury, illness, disability or ageing to improve movement and general wellbeing. In this role, you will have the opportunity to independently manage a varied caseload of NDIS Clients including Private Patients, DVA, Workcover & EPC Clients.

What we offer:
? An Employer/Employee Value Proposition like you never experienced
? Competitive salary and benefits package
? Ongoing professional learning and development including mentoring and coaching
? A diverse and inclusive work environment
? Career pathways and networking opportunities
? Organised 1:1’s, fortnightly teaching and journal clubs
? Fully equipped practices with pilates reformer, shock therapy, acupuncture, exercise physiology, massage therapy, computerised gait analysis, advanced posture screening software, OH&S training and rehabilitation, manual handling seminars

What you offer:
? Bachelor degree or higher qualification in Occupational Therapy
? AHPRA registration required
? At least 2 years’ experience as a registered Occupational Therapist with 1-year experience in private practice
? Understanding of the rights of people with a disability
? Current Valid Driver's License
?Current Working with Children Check or willingness to obtain one before commencement

Are you interested? Apply today.

result.description:
Global Vision Recruitment on Behalf of Technosoft Australia

Date Posted: 28 July 2026

Position: ICT Help Desk

Salary: $76,550 - $90,000 per annum plus 12% superannuation

Hours: 38 hours

Mode: Full-time

Location: Level 19, 180 Lonsdale Street, Melbourne VIC 3000

Experience required: Minimum 1 year of relevant ICT support or help desk experience

Technosoft Australia is a growing IT services and digital solutions company specialising in website development, app development, digital strategy, IT support, and business technology solutions for a wide range of clients across Australia. The company provides innovative and reliable technology services with a strong focus on customer satisfaction, technical support, and digital transformation solutions.

We are currently seeking a motivated and skilled ICT Help Desk Officer to join our growing technical support team. This role is ideal for a candidate with strong troubleshooting skills, excellent communication abilities, and a passion for providing high-quality IT support services to clients and internal users.

The successful candidate will be responsible for providing technical assistance and support related to hardware, software, systems, and network issues while ensuring prompt resolution of technical problems.

Key Responsibilities:

•	Provide first-level technical support to clients and internal staff via phone, email, and remote support tools

•	Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, system, and network-related issues

•	Install, configure, and maintain computer systems, software applications, and peripheral devices

•	Escalate complex technical issues to senior IT staff when required

•	Maintain accurate records of support requests, troubleshooting activities, and system updates

•	Assist with user account management, password resets, and access permissions

•	Support website, application, and system maintenance activities where required

•	Monitor system performance and identify potential technical issues proactively

•	Assist in maintaining IT security standards, backups, and software updates

•	Provide guidance and training to users on basic IT systems and applications

•	Ensure all support tasks are completed within agreed service timeframes

•	Collaborate with internal teams to support ongoing technology projects and improvements

•	Maintain a professional and customer-focused approach when handling support requests

Qualifications:

•	Tertiary qualification in Information Technology, ICT, Computer Science, or related field

•	Minimum 1 year of relevant ICT support or help desk experience

Skills and Other Requirements:

•	Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

•	Knowledge of Windows operating systems, Microsoft Office, networking, and basic server administration

•	Excellent verbal and written communication skills

•	Ability to work independently and within a team environment

•	Strong time management and organisational skills

•	Customer service-focused attitude with the ability to work under pressure

Email your resume to recruit@gvrc.com.au.
